scope: 13 training plus4 geometry-held-out validation configurations,90s, generic10/16m canopy patches and synthetic wood facade. Not a calibrated physical reference.
state_interface: Vegetation per-class temperature distributions, mass, emitted fuel and measured incoming radiation/convection; facade patch temperatures, heating and ignition. Inputs at inference are geometry/materials/wind/moisture and prescribed initialization only.
confounding: Gap, wind and moisture co-vary in this tiny pilot; no independent sensitivities can be claimed. Validation holds whole configurations, not time rows. Cold initial states with prescribed20s heating pulses, not pre-burned canopy states.
test_rule: Exact larger-scene geometry must be frozen before model selection; predictions and model hashes frozen before accessing any held-out FDS output.
